title: terragucci.versions/v1
description: versions.json in a project's directory of a reports prefix: the binary, provider and module versions each root runs, as its newest applied tf-apply wave left them. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

commit.description: The applied commit the versions were read at.

finished.description: When the wave that recorded them finished.

path.description: The wave's run directory, relative to the project's index.json.

environment.description: The environment of environments: in terragucci.yml the root was in when the wave applied. Absent when it was in none.

binary.description: The binary the root ran, as the report's roots[].binary names it: its name, its version, and where the root pinned it.

providers.description: Each provider the root's .terraform.lock.hcl locks, by its full address.

modules.description: Each remote module call init recorded in .terraform/modules/modules.json, nested calls included. Local calls are left out.

call.description: The call's address: module.vpc, or module.vpc.module.nat for a nested call.

source.description: The source modules.json records, without its ? query.

version.description: The registry version init resolved, else the ref, tag or version the source's query names. Absent when the source names none.
